Help the [[Forgotten]] get revenge on the [[Margonite]]s by killing any that you encounter.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill 40 Margonites. You have destroyed [0...40] Margonite[s].
* See Vissh Rakissh for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* 30 [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer Points]]

==Walkthrough==
Find and kill 40 Margonites, then return to Vissh for your reward.  The Margonites can be from any area, they do not have to be found in [[The Desolation]]; however, killing Margonites in the [[Domain of Anguish]] do not count towards the 40 Margonites killed.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Vissh Rakissh
:''"The '''Margonites''' have hunted my brethren like animals. No matter how hard we fought back, eventually we fell. They allow me to live, only to mock my suffering. Pay them back for the deaths of my brothers and I will reward you."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll teach them a lesson they won't soon forget.
|decline = You make a great pet.
|ask = Go, find the Margonites. Bring them pain and vengeance for each of the Forgotten they mercilessly hunted down. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Vissh Rakissh
:''"I am in your debt, <Character name>. The Margonites may not be defeated, but at least my brethren's deaths have been avenged. Their souls are free,"''

==Notes==
* Vissh's master difficulty quest [[The Cold Touch of the Past]] and its followup provide enough Margonites to complete this quest. This quest can also be completed at the same time as [[Getting Even]].
* Plenty of Margonites can also be found in [[Vabbi]] and the [[Realm of Torment]] to fulfill the requirements of this quest.  Most likely, players will complete it by simply playing through the storyline if they pick it up before arriving in the Realm of Torment.
* This quest is very similar to [[Wicked Wardens]] in the [[Factions]] campaign.
